svg.title: Installed release and runtime state connections
svg.desc: Inputs, outputs, durable state, evidence, failure, and recovery relationships for Installed release and runtime state.

g.text: Installed release and runtime state connections

a.xlink:title: Installed release and runtime state. Stores installed-release identity and release-runtime projection for truthful comparison, staging, apply, rollback, and last-known-good state.
SQLite control-plane store. Stores canonical Lite lifecycle state and prepared projections; the frontend never accesses it directly.
Release subprocess. Owns network, download, verification, staging, apply, and rollback work outside the FastAPI event loop.
Post-switch health validation. Validates Caddy/FastAPI/PWA health after promotion before declaring the release current.
